doc.brief: A `GtkShortcutsGroup` represents a group of related keyboard shortcuts or gestures.
doc.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
doc.md:
A `GtkShortcutsGroup` represents a group of related keyboard shortcuts
or gestures.

The group has a title. It may optionally be associated with a view
of the application, which can be used to show only relevant shortcuts
depending on the application context.

This widget is only meant to be used with [`ShortcutsWindow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsWindow).

The recommended way to construct a `GtkShortcutsGroup` is with
[`Builder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Builder), by using the `<child>` tag to populate a
`GtkShortcutsGroup` with one or more [`ShortcutsShortcut`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsShortcut)
instances.

If you need to add a shortcut programmatically, use
[`ShortcutsGroup.add_shortcut()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsGroup#method:add_shortcut).

add_shortcut.brief: Adds a shortcut to the shortcuts group.
add_shortcut.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
add_shortcut.md:
Adds a shortcut to the shortcuts group.

This is the programmatic equivalent to using [`Builder`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Builder) and a
`<child>` tag to add the child. Adding children with other API is not
appropriate as `GtkShortcutsGroup` manages its children internally.

accel-size-group.brief: The size group for the accelerator portion of shortcuts in this group.
accel-size-group.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
accel-size-group.md:
The size group for the accelerator portion of shortcuts in this group.

This is used internally by GTK, and must not be modified by applications.

height.brief: A rough measure for the number of lines in this group.
height.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
height.md:
A rough measure for the number of lines in this group.

This is used internally by GTK, and is not useful for applications.

title.brief: The title for this group of shortcuts.
title.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
title.md: The title for this group of shortcuts.

title-size-group.brief: The size group for the textual portion of shortcuts in this group.
title-size-group.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
title-size-group.md:
The size group for the textual portion of shortcuts in this group.

This is used internally by GTK, and must not be modified by applications.

view.brief: An optional view that the shortcuts in this group are relevant for.
view.deprecated_md: This widget will be removed in GTK 5
view.md:
An optional view that the shortcuts in this group are relevant for.

The group will be hidden if the [`ShortcutsWindow:view-name`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ShortcutsWindow#property:view-name)
property does not match the view of this group.

Set this to `NULL` to make the group always visible.
